title: GPTAuditPublisherConfig
description: Configuration schema for publisher mandatory parameters in gpt-audit

publisher.description: Name of the publisher, network, or audit profile

ppid.description: If true, mandates that all display ad requests include a Publisher Provided Identifier (PPID)

requestParams.description: List of query parameters required in GAM ad requests (e.g. 'ppid')

custParams.description: List of custom targeting keys required in ad request cust_params

pageTargeting.description: List of targeting keys required in googletag.pubads().setTargeting()

slotTargeting.description: List of targeting keys required on every defined slot

minSlots.description: Minimum expected count of defined ad slots on the page

requiredElementIds.description: List of specific slot element IDs that must be present on page

requireSafeFrame.description: If true, mandates that rendered creatives use SafeFrames

requireSra.description: If true, mandates that Single Request Architecture (SRA) is enabled
